name: Monsoon Drape
description: A flowing handloom saree woven by master craftspeople in the Kandy district. Each piece takes three days to complete on a traditional pit loom, creating an intricate texture that is both contemporary and deeply rooted in Sri Lankan heritage.
fabric: 100% pure handloom cotton with natural dyes sourced from the Knuckles mountain range.
shipping: Complimentary shipping on all orders over USD 300. Standard delivery 7–14 business days. Express available.

name: Ivory Linen Set
description: Effortlessly refined. This kurta-palazzo set is crafted from handwoven linen, produced in a small family-run workshop in Jaffna. The natural ivory tones are achieved without chemical bleaching.
fabric: Belgian linen warp, handspun cotton weft. Naturally bleached in sunlight.
shipping: Complimentary shipping on all orders over USD 300. Standard delivery 7–14 business days.

name: Cinnamon Pleats
description: Named for the warmth of freshly harvested cinnamon, this silk saree carries the colour of the spice and the spirit of the island. Woven in Galle with a fine zari border.
fabric: Mulberry silk with 22-karat gold zari border. Hand-dyed with natural cinnamon bark extract.
shipping: Complimentary shipping on all orders over USD 300. Standard delivery 7–14 business days.

name: Lotus Field
description: Inspired by the lotus-covered tanks of Anuradhapura. This pure silk saree carries a hand-embroidered lotus motif along the pallu, each bloom requiring four hours of work by a single artisan.
fabric: Pure Kanjivaram silk with hand-embroidered silk thread work. Dry clean only.
shipping: Complimentary shipping on all orders over USD 300. Express delivery 3–5 days available.

name: Temple Weave
description: Woven on ancient temple looms in Polonnaruwa, this dupatta carries geometric patterns drawn from the stone carvings of 12th century Sri Lankan architecture.
fabric: Handwoven cotton with natural indigo dye. Block-printed border.
shipping: Complimentary shipping on all orders over USD 300. Standard delivery 7–14 business days.

name: Dusk Linen Dress
description: The Dusk dress captures the amber light of a Colombo evening. Cut in a relaxed silhouette from hand-washed linen, it falls with the languid ease of island time.
fabric: Enzyme-washed handloom linen. 100% natural fibre. Machine wash cold.
shipping: Limited edition — 12 pieces only. Complimentary express shipping worldwide.

name: Saffron Trail
description: A structured blouse in hand-dyed saffron cotton, designed to be worn with both sarees and contemporary bottoms. The collar references the necklines seen in ancient Sigiriya frescoes.
fabric: Handloom cotton dyed with saffron and turmeric. Cold wash only.
shipping: Complimentary shipping on all orders over USD 300. Standard delivery 7–14 business days.

name: Ceylon Garden
description: A co-ordinate set inspired by the botanical gardens of Peradeniya. Block-printed botanicals on handwoven cotton create a garment that feels both wild and considered.
fabric: Handwoven cotton with botanical block print using plant-based inks. Hand wash cold.
shipping: Complimentary shipping on all orders over USD 300. Standard delivery 7–14 business days.
